messages:
eva: onboarding blocked — python quickstart uses the new async responses API but pip has redwood==0.8.3 which only exposes client.generate/client.chat. got AttributeError: 'RedwoodClient' object has no attribute 'responses' and the quickstart nav link returned 404.

tom: thanks for the report. sounds like docs drifted to the beta runtime shape. can you paste the exact snippet you ran?

eva: snippet from docs: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
async def main():
    resp = await client.responses.create("hi")
    print(resp.output_text)
```
error when running: AttributeError: 'RedwoodClient' object has no attribute 'responses'

mia: yep, docs updated ahead of release. plan: (1) revert quickstart to show stable v0.8 usage and a pinned pip install line, (2) add a short note pointing to /beta for async examples, (3) introduce a tiny mypy-safe example and pin the code block to the package version.

docs-bot: docs build failed at 2026-03-18T15:22:09Z — missing page python/quickstart. Issue opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/752

ci-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/772 by mia — reverts async snippet, pins example to redwood==0.8.3, and adds a compatibility note. Running docs build + link-checker.

tom: also filing a follow-up to add a docs CI step that runs code excerpts against the pinned package to catch drift. ticket #1130.

eva: thanks — will re-run onboarding after the PR merges and report back if anything else breaks. :thumbsup:
